issue.subject: Tickets with tag, root-cause, new-customer or low-usage signals are routed to NOC
issue.description:
NOC-AUTO S8

**Statement:** As a NOC Manager, I need tickets tagged Night Check or Android Box, or with root cause Termination Saved or Password and SSID Changed, routed to NOC, and tickets of new customers (plan started under 30 days ago) or with low usage in the last 24 hours routed to NOC for manual follow-up instead of being remotely resolved, so that these cases are not auto-resolved.

**PRD:** https://rnd.frontiir.net/en/products/rt/requirements/noc-ticket-automation-prd

**ACs (4):**

- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC28` Night Check or Android Box: When the tags include Night Check or Android Box the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC29` Termination Saved or Password and SSID Changed: When Root Cause is Termination Saved or Password & SSID Changed the ticket moves to NOC with the matching fields and comment.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC30` New customer (plan start under 30 days): When the plan start date is less than 30 days ago, regardless of usage, the ticket moves to NOC with SAI Customer Site, RCC Customer-CPE and the 30-day comment. It is not remotely resolved and not flagged Manual Check. Business intent: follow up with a new customer manually to avoid churn.
- `RT-NOC-AUTO-AC31` Low usage in 24 hours: When AC30 does not apply and ONU usage in the last 24 hours is under 1 GB (exactly 1 GB does not count), the ticket moves to NOC with SAI Customer Site, RCC Customer-CPE and the low-usage comment. It is not flagged Manual Check. When usage is missing (Node-RED error 2008) this AC does not apply: see S4 AC11. Business intent: low usage may point to an issue Remote Resolve does not cover.

**Notes / dependencies:** AC30 and AC31 are ordinary Workflow Engine rules (queue NOC, no status change), not Manual Check. Manual Check means a ticket eligible for Remote Resolve that cannot complete because of a transient failure. Order of the usage step in the engine: over 1 GB goes to Remote Resolve; otherwise false with error goes to the Node-RED error route (S4 AC11); otherwise false goes to NOC.

**Open points:**

- AC30: Decided 2026-11-18 (usage rule 2 of 2). As written it is already covered by AC31: PM to confirm the intent. Manual Check has no RT comment.
- AC31: Decided 2026-11-18 (usage rule 1 of 2). Under 1 GB triggers; exactly 1 GB does not. Engine compares 24h_onu_usage_gb < 1 (#21503 has no under-1 GB flag). Behaviour when usage is missing (error 2008) is open. Manual Check has no RT comment.

**Implementation status:** code exists on the feature branch, unvalidated. Tasks to be refined by Dev after the Story is agreed.

**Related (reference only):** #21613, #22265
